headlines.headline: NBA clubs trim rosters to 15 as season-opening tripleheader nears
headlines.detail: Teams finalized rosters Saturday ahead of Tuesday's three-game opening night, waiving the bulk of Exhibit 9 and 10 camp invitees. Orlando's Noah Penda (torn hamstring) and Denver's Julian Strawther (six weeks, knee) will open the season out, while Giannis Antetokounmpo debuts with Miami Tuesday against Orlando.

headlines.headline: Trade frenzy continues: Giants, Steelers, Eagles all make moves before Nov. 10 deadline
headlines.detail: Days after Arizona sent Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston, the Giants added QB J.J. McCarthy, Pittsburgh dealt Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas, and Philadelphia sent center Cam Jurgens to Baltimore. The Chargers' Khalil Mack and Jacksonville's Brian Thomas Jr. are next up in trade rumors.

headlines.headline: No. 8 BYU stuns No. 2 Notre Dame 28-24 in Week 7's wildest Saturday
headlines.detail: Bear Bachmeier's late TD pass to Walker Lyons lifted BYU to the biggest win in program history. Also Saturday: Ohio State escaped Indiana 19-15 (losing QB Julian Sayin to injury), Florida rallied past Texas 27-24, and Tennessee routed Alabama 26-10.

headlines.headline: Florida tabbed No. 1 in SEC preseason media poll as AP Top 25 nears release
headlines.detail: The Gators are the SEC's preseason pick, with Duke projected as their closest rival for the national No. 1 spot once the AP poll drops. The two meet Dec. 1 in the ACC/SEC Challenge; the season tips off Nov. 2.
